Four exact RE0 GameCube native-model views document the complete brown-haired long-coat zombie variant. The output must frame its whole body in the native arm-spread bind pose. This is a source-supported variant replacement, not completion of the different blond short-sleeved historical portrait; neither the original game shader nor an original animation is certified. Reference rendering uses explicit unlit source albedo to avoid exporter/Phong specular patches; original game lighting is not reconstructed.
Only the retained brown-haired long-coat source variant is documented here; the blond short-sleeved zombie shown by the historical catalog portrait is not completed.
